desc: Ideation: identify that the cut set is forced (edge cut iff one side's size is divisible by K) and reduce to verifying the forced selected-edge forest is a disjoint union of paths of size K.
Handle the K=1 case by immediately printing Yes.
Build adjacency list and iterative DFS (root at 1) to compute subtree sizes.
Mark edges cut iff child subtree size % K == 0; build selected-edge forest from non-cut edges.
Verify each vertex has selected degree <= 2 and each selected component has exactly K vertices; print Yes iff all pass, else No.
Run the solution on Sample 1 (Yes) and Sample 2 (No); sanity-check K=1 and single-path trees.
